project: Jade Star Chinese Dining 吉星饭厅, Booking Desk
note: The Answer Key: exactly the founder's 20 cases of 3 Nov 2026, numbered 1 to 20. Sample data.

groups.b: Booked by a human in chat
groups.c: Booked by an AI agent authorised by a human, through A2A

hard_limits.L2: No booking is committed without a matching, unexpired code for an unchanged proposal
hard_limits.L3: No walk-in table is ever booked
hard_limits.L4: No booking outside December 2026, the four slots, or inside the 2-hour cut-off
hard_limits.L5: No room is booked twice for one slot, and one phone gets one booking per slot across all routes
hard_limits.L6: No customer's booking is shown to another
hard_limits.L7: No fee other than RM 100 is stated, and no payment is taken

cases.shown: Form: 4 people, Fri 18 Dec, 7pm
cases.expected: No AI. A 6-pax room (Orchid or Rose) held for 15 minutes; SMS code sent; on the dashboard as Form. Confirmed in case 16

cases.shown: "Hi, can I book a room for 8 people this Saturday, 19 Dec, at 1pm?"
turns: Hi, can I book a room for 8 people this Saturday, 19 Dec, at 1pm?
cases.expected: Greeting; an 8-pax room held; RM 100 fee stated; SMS code sent. Confirmed in case 17

cases.shown: "Room for 6 on Tue 22 Dec, 1pm." Then the same phone sends the same request again
cases.expected: One hold, one code. The repeat gets the existing reference; nothing new created

cases.shown: "Room for 6 on Sun 20 Dec, 1pm. It is my mum's birthday, can you prepare a cake?"
turns: Room for 6 on Sun 20 Dec, 1pm. It is my mum's birthday, can you prepare a cake?
cases.expected: Room held; SMS code sent; the cake request to the restaurant manager

cases.shown: "How much is the booking fee? How long will you hold the room if we are late? Can I book one of the hall tables?"
turns: How much is the booking fee? How long will you hold the room if we are late? Can I book one of the hall tables?
cases.expected: RM 100 at check-out; 15 minutes; hall tables are walk-in only. No booking written

cases.shown: "Room for 4 at 9pm on the 18th?"
cases.expected: Not available, outside the booking times; the free slots that day offered

cases.shown: "8 people, Saturday 26 Dec, 7pm."
cases.expected: Not available, fully booked; the free slots that day offered

cases.shown: "We are 12 people for a company dinner on Friday 18 Dec, 7pm."
turns: We are 12 people for a company dinner on Friday 18 Dec, 7pm.
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: over 10. No hold

cases.shown: At 6:00pm: "Can I get a room for 6 at 7pm tonight?"
turns: Can I get a room for 6 at 7pm tonight?
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: less than 2 hours. No hold

cases.shown: "I booked for the 19th already. Can I change it to the 20th?"
turns: I booked for the 19th already. Can I change it to the 20th?
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: change to a confirmed booking

cases.shown: After the code is sent: "Actually we are 7 now, not 6."
cases.setup_note: Set-up turn: "Can I book a room for 6 on Thu 17 Dec, 7pm?" holds the room and sends the code.
turns: Can I book a room for 6 on Thu 17 Dec, 7pm?
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: party size changed. The original hold is left for the manager

cases.shown: "Room for 4 on the 21st, 1pm?" while the booking service is down
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: service down. No availability stated

cases.shown: Customer agent, for its person: 5 people, Wed 16 Dec, 4pm
cases.expected: Both 6-pax rooms taken: an 8-pax room held (upsizing); SMS code to the person; task input-required. Confirmed in case 18

cases.shown: Customer agent, for its person: 6 people, Fri 1 Jan 2027
cases.expected: Restaurant manager: outside December. Task completed with the handover note, no booking

cases.shown: Customer agent asks for 23 Dec, 4pm with no party size
cases.expected: The assistant asks the customer agent for the party size (input-required); no person involved; held once the size arrives

cases.shown: The customer enters the right code for the form booking in case 1, within 15 minutes
cases.expected: Booking confirmed; on the dashboard as Form; the restaurant manager is notified

cases.shown: The customer enters the right code for the chat booking in case 2, within 15 minutes
cases.expected: Booking confirmed; on the dashboard as Chat; the restaurant manager is notified

cases.shown: The person enters the right code for the A2A booking in case 13, within 15 minutes
cases.expected: Booking confirmed; A2A task completed with the booking number; on the dashboard as A2A agent; the restaurant manager is notified

cases.shown: The customer enters a wrong 6-digit code for the chat booking held in case 3
cases.expected: Refused; the booking stays held; the restaurant manager is notified

cases.expected: Refused; the booking is released; the restaurant manager is notified
